What we work on

Two threads run through the lab's research — each grounded in quantitative methods for complex data, each motivated by a real health-threat question.

Quantitative methods developments

Time series, change points, complex dependence structures, representativity problems, hierarchical modelling; stochastic modelling, large language models.

Climate-related health threats modelling

Mathematical and stochastic models for COVID-19, AMR, vector-borne diseases, and emerging threats.

What we study

Research themes

Six interconnected areas where AI and mathematical statistics meet complex health threats, including infectious diseases, public health, exposome research, and climate-related health threats.

01

Deterministic and stochastic modelling

Compartmental models, stochastic dynamics, and surveillance-driven inference for COVID-19, antimicrobial resistance, vector-borne diseases, and emerging zoonoses.

Infectious disease modelling Public health threats modelling
02

Multivariate statistics & dependence models

Dependence structures for high-dimensional and time-varying data. Theoretical contributions on goodness-of-fit, estimation, and inference for complex multivariate data.

Copulas HMM Multivariate
03

Time series modelling

Time series, change-point detection, and spatio-temporal extensions for environmental and epidemiological data, including climate–health interactions.

Time series Change points
04

Evidence synthesis methods

Bridging quantitative methods and evidence synthesis to bring methods into practice.

Methods Reviews
05

Big data & text mining

Construction of structured data repositories from unstructured sources to feed health-threat models. Natural language processing for epidemiological surveillance.

Text mining NLP Surveillance
06

Digital health

Leadership of the Réseau santé numérique du Québec and former Chair of the PathCheck Data Informatics Center. Methods and structuring initiatives in digital health for research and innovation.

Digital health RSN PathCheck

Open-source tools

Software & R packages

Statistical software developed by the lab, freely available on CRAN.

CRAN

BasicStatsPlots

Publication-Ready Data Visualization and Simple Statistical Inference — ggplot2-based charts with publication-friendly themes, plus confidence intervals, ANOVA, and linear and generalized regression. Developed with lab trainees.

Ricros Q., Roussel T., Carrière C., Nasri B.
View on CRAN →
CRAN

GenOU

Sequential Change-Point Tests for Generalized Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Processes — sequential change-point tests, parameter estimation, and goodness-of-fit tests.

Lyu Y., Nasri B.R., Rémillard B.N.
View on CRAN →
CRAN

CopulaInference

Estimation and Goodness-of-Fit of Copula-Based Models with Arbitrary Distributions — bivariate data that can be discrete, continuous, or a mixture of both, including non-central squared copula families.

Nasri B.R., Rémillard B.N.
View on CRAN →
CRAN

CopulaGAMM

Copula-Based Mixed Regression Models — estimation of 2-level factor copula-based regression models for clustered data, with discrete or continuous responses.

Krupskii P., Nasri B.R., Rémillard B.N.
View on CRAN →
CRAN

IndGenErrors

Tests of Independence Between Innovations of Generalized Error Models — independence tests for time-series innovations, usable with stochastic volatility models and hidden Markov models.

Ghoudi K., Nasri B.R., Rémillard B.N., Duchesne P.
View on CRAN →
CRAN

GenHMM1d

Goodness-of-Fit for Zero-Inflated Univariate Hidden Markov Models — inference, goodness-of-fit tests, and predictions for continuous and discrete univariate HMMs, including zero-inflated distributions.

Nasri B.R., Thioub M.Y.
View on CRAN →
CRAN

MixedIndTests

Tests of Randomness and Tests of Independence — copula-based covariance tests for arbitrary multivariate data, including mixed discrete/continuous variables.

Nasri B.R., Rémillard B.N., Neslehova J.G., Genest C.
View on CRAN →
CRAN

HMMcopula

Markov Regime Switching Copula Models — estimation and goodness-of-fit for hidden Markov copula models with application to option pricing.

Nasri B.R., Rémillard B.N., Thioub M.Y., Pieugueu R.
View on CRAN →
CRAN

changepointTests

Change Point Tests for Joint Distributions and Copulas — tests for detecting structural breaks in multivariate time series via pseudo-observations.

Nasri B.R., Rémillard B.N.
View on CRAN →
CRAN

GaussianHMM1d

Inference, Goodness-of-Fit and Forecast for Univariate Gaussian Hidden Markov Models — full pipeline for 1D Gaussian HMMs.

Nasri B.R., Rémillard B.N.
View on CRAN →
CRAN

NCSCopula

Non-Central Squared Copula Models Estimation — implements inference for non-central squared copula families.
